ambient_events: A blackened stalk in the Blight crumbles to soot at the touch of the wind.
Something worth having glints in the dead ground, and the dead ground does not want to give it up.
description: A blighted flat above the Slagworks Gate where nothing that tries to grow gets past a hand's height before it blackens and gives up. The salvage here is good; the ground insists you earn it.
name: The Blight
